source: Live Master Scribe and Oracle RPG dialogue pages in useNightOneFlow.ts
voice_plan: Master Scribe and Oracle each use a distinct approved character voice.
voice_settings: Uses each saved ElevenLabs voice configuration; the generator does not override voice settings.
speech_normalization: Typographic dashes, ellipses, and the UI breadcrumb arrow are normalized for speech.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Traveler... At last.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: You have crossed the threshold and arrived in the Grey Commons. Every path in the Horizon begins here. The roads stretch in every direction. Some lead to prosperity. Some to purpose. Yet from where you stand, they all appear hidden by fog.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: This is the Scroll of Destiny. One day it will contain the story of your journey. But today - its pages are blank. As they should be.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Before the Scroll can guide you, you must first discover who you are. Beyond these fields stands the Mirror of Maia. Seek it. Learn what it reveals. Then return to me.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: The Mirror of Maia awaits, Traveler. Beyond these fields - seek it. Return when you have glimpsed your first sign.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: The Echoes grow bolder.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: They gather where purpose is unclear.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Stand with me, Traveler.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Drive them back.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Good. The Echoes have scattered.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: You have learned that some uncertainty must be faced directly.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Now return to the Mirror of Maia.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Your next sign is waiting.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Well done, Traveler.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: You drove back the Echoes of doubt.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: But there is one more you must face.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: This Echo is different.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Steel alone will not scatter it.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Force will not help you here.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: This Echo questions.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: It tests what you know - not how hard you can strike.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Approach it and press Enter.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Answer with what you have learned.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: The Echo glows nearby.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Find it when you are ready.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Well answered.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Not every Echo is defeated by force.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Some fade only when met with understanding.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Return to Maia, Traveler.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: The next reflection awaits.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Every Traveler needs more than courage and reflection.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: They need records.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Tools.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Maps.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Memories.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Open the Scroll of Destiny.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Find what it remembers.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Good.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: The Scroll will remember what the mind forgets.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: One reflection remains.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Return to Maia and seek your Foretold Signposts.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.trigger: MQ-109 active or available, before Scroll reveal
clips.text: The Scroll has awakened.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.trigger: MQ-109 active or available, before Scroll reveal
clips.text: Wait...
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: This should not be here.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Your first signs are clear... but something else has marked the Scroll.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: I can record what the Scroll reveals. I cannot interpret what has awakened beneath it.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: The Oracle must see this. Find the shrine beyond the path, and return to me when her vision is complete.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: The Oracle Shrine lies beyond the Grey Commons.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Seek it.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: The Scroll has awakened - but only the Oracle can make its runes legible.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: You heard the Oracle.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: The Runes have settled - and they may now be read.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Three Foretold Signposts are sealed on your Scroll.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: They are not your destiny.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: They are not a verdict.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: They are the first roads asking to be examined.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: The Oracle also burned a mark into your Scroll.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: That mark is a link - a real-world research source about one of your signpost paths.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Open your Scroll of Destiny and look for the Oracle's brand.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Click it.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Read.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Take notes.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: That is your next task: not choosing a career, but learning how a Traveler studies a road before walking it.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: I have placed the Quest of Fate in your Field Journal.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Open the Scroll of Destiny, then Field Journal, then Work Files.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: Your document will be waiting there.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.text: When your teacher creates your personal copy in Google Drive, you will find a link in Work Files as well.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.speaker: master_scribe
clips.trigger: No Act I or Act II Scribe quest branch is active
clips.text: The guild roads are open, Traveler. Follow the Scroll of Destiny and gather evidence before choosing your path.
clips.voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

clips.voice_direction: Distinct ageless feminine Oracle: clear, serene, lightly ethereal, intimate, and unnervingly calm.

clips.speaker: oracle

clips.voice_direction: Distinct ageless feminine Oracle: clear, serene, lightly ethereal, intimate, and unnervingly calm.

clips.speaker: oracle

clips.voice_direction: Distinct ageless feminine Oracle: clear, serene, lightly ethereal, intimate, and unnervingly calm.

clips.text: The scroll hums in your hands...
clips.voice_direction: Distinct ageless feminine Oracle: clear, serene, lightly ethereal, intimate, and unnervingly calm.

clips.speaker: oracle
clips.text: Your signposts stir...
clips.voice_direction: Distinct ageless feminine Oracle: clear, serene, lightly ethereal, intimate, and unnervingly calm.

clips.speaker: oracle
clips.text: The threads of your fate converge...
clips.voice_direction: Distinct ageless feminine Oracle: clear, serene, lightly ethereal, intimate, and unnervingly calm.
